data.title: 诱宵美九 · 晨曦真丝床榻的歌姬浅笑
data.description: 清晨的第一缕微金晨光洒在真丝大床上，泛着淡紫色的温润光泽。美九趴在柔软的丝绒被褥间，薄透的薰衣草色真丝睡裙勾勒出极其惹火的曲线。她两手托着精致小巧的下巴，小腿在身后轻快地前后晃动，银紫色的眼眸盈满了甜蜜与依赖，用只对你一人倾诉的娇柔歌声呼唤着你的名字。
data.location: sunlit penthouse master bed with lavender silk sheets
data.action: lying on stomach on luxury silk bed, sheer lavender silk nightdress, swinging bare feet in air, chin in hands, affectionate starry-eyed gaze at viewer
data.lighting: pure morning sunbeams illuminating sheer lavender silk and silver hair
data.mood: adoring romantic worship, sweet playful morning happiness
data.promptProse: Lying playfully on her stomach on a lavish silk bed, Miku rests her chin in her hands in a sheer lavender nightgown. Her silver-purple hair shimmers in morning sunbeams as her feet kick gently in the air with pure love.
data.animaCaption: Miku lying on a silk bed in a sheer lavender nightgown, smiling adoringly in the morning sun.
